description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Notification to revise the fees charged for the Consular Services Provided by the Sri Lanka Missions/Posts abroad under the provisions of Consular Function Act, No. 04 of 1981
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Consular Functions Act, No. 4 of 1981 and specifies new regulatory fees for various consular services. It establishes a legal framework for fee structures and compliance requirements, making it a regulatory matter that falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the regulatory function being established, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes described.
